seo.title: Decibel — Sound Level Meter for iOS
seo.description: Measure sound levels instantly with real-time dB readings, NIOSH exposure warnings, and HealthKit integration. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: SOUND LEVEL METER
hero.title: Measure sound levels instantly.
text: A precise decibel meter with NIOSH safety warnings. Know when noise becomes harmful and protect your hearing.

items.title: Real-Time dB Meter
items.text: Large, easy-to-read display shows current decibel levels instantly. Track peak and average readings during your measurement sessions.

items.title: NIOSH Exposure Warnings
items.text: Color-coded safety alerts based on occupational standards. Know exactly how long you can safely be exposed to current noise levels.

items.title: Save Readings
items.text: Store measurements with notes for later reference. Export your history to CSV for analysis or record-keeping.

items.title: HealthKit Integration
items.text: Record environmental audio exposure to Apple Health. Track your hearing health over time alongside your other health data.

items.title: Session History
items.text: Every measurement is saved automatically. Review past readings, track trends, and build awareness of your noise exposure.

items.title: Completely Private
items.text: No accounts, no cloud sync, no tracking. Your sound measurements stay on your device. We never hear a thing.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No telemetry. Decibel processes audio locally on your device. We never record, store, or transmit any audio.

cta.title: Start measuring.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
